question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

To me, this was both a perfect **__articulation__** of the problem and the suggestion of a solution.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"articulation"** means the clear and precise pronunciation of words or the expression of thoughts and ideas in a clear and effective manner. (स्पष्ट उच्चारण या अभिव्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **articulation **of the complex topic was impressive and easy to understand.
 
 
 
• **"Enunciation" **refers to the act of pronouncing words clearly and distinctly, similar to articulation. (उच्चारण)
 
 
• **Example: **Good **enunciation** is essential for effective communication.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'articulation' **is **'enunciation'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Park **(पार्क): An area of public land in a town or city where people go to walk, play, and relax.

 
 
• **Example:** The children are playing in the park.
 
 
 
• **Mispronounce **(गलत उच्चारण करना): To pronounce a word incorrectly.
 
 
• **Example: **He tends to mispronounce foreign words.
 
 
 
• **Damp** (गीला): Slightly wet.
 
 
• **Example:** The clothes were still damp after being in the dryer.
